description: This file defines an object pool for InternalKafkaConsumer instances, grouped by CacheKey, within Spark's Kafka integration. It manages creation, borrowing, returning, invalidation, and cleanup of pooled Kafka consumers, with configuration for pool capacity and eviction policies.

classes.name: InternalKafkaConsumerPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of InternalKafkaConsumer instances grouped by CacheKey, providing thread-safe borrowing, returning, invalidation, and cleanup operations with configurable pool settings.

classes.name: InternalKafkaConsumerPool.PoolConfig
classes.description: Configures pool parameters such as capacity, eviction policies, and thread management based on SparkConf.

classes.name: InternalKafkaConsumerPool.ObjectFactory
classes.description: Creates and destroys InternalKafkaConsumer instances, maintaining a mapping of CacheKey to Kafka parameters.

methods.name: borrowObject
methods.description: Borrows an InternalKafkaConsumer from the pool for a given CacheKey and Kafka parameters, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: returnObject
methods.description: Returns a borrowed InternalKafkaConsumer to the pool.

methods.name: invalidateObject
methods.description: Invalidates (destroys) a borrowed InternalKafkaConsumer, removing it from the pool.

methods.name: invalidateKey
methods.description: Invalidates all idle consumers associated with a specific CacheKey.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the entire object pool, destroying all idle instances.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the pool of all idle objects, attempting to reset the pool state.

methods.name: numIdle
methods.description: Returns the number of idle consumers in the pool.

methods.name: numIdle
methods.description: Returns the number of idle consumers for a specific CacheKey.

methods.name: numActive
methods.description: Returns the number of active (borrowed) consumers in the pool.

methods.name: numActive
methods.description: Returns the number of active consumers for a specific CacheKey.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of consumers (active + idle).

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of consumers for a specific CacheKey.

methods.name: numActiveInGroupIdPrefix
methods.description: Returns the number of active consumers with group IDs starting with a given prefix.

methods.name: updateKafkaParamForKey
methods.description: Associates Kafka parameters with a CacheKey, ensuring consistency for reuse.

methods.name: extractCacheKey
methods.description: Extracts a CacheKey from an InternalKafkaConsumer instance.
